theorem_title: Long-Wagner Conjecture 5.1: a cube-free set mod $2^n$ has size at most $\frac{5}{8}2^n$
natural_language_statement:
Let $n \ge 4$ and let $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/2^n\mathbb{Z}$ be cube-free. Then $8|A| \le 5 \cdot 2^n$, that is $|A| \le \frac{5}{8}2^n$.

This is Conjecture 5.1 of Long and Wagner (2018). The set $\{v : v \bmod 8 \in \{1,3,4,5,7\}\}$ attains the constant.
source: Jason Long and Adam Zsolt Wagner, "The largest projective cube-free subsets of Z_{2^n}", arXiv:1810.01225, https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.01225, Conjecture 5.1
